features.title: Plan, then tick off

features.title: Counts that add up

features.title: Your data, your copy

faq.q: Is Habit Tracker free?
faq.a: Yes. There are no ads and no account.

faq.q: How do I add a topic to several days at once?
faq.a: Tap a day, pick the topic, then switch to **Date range** and choose the last day. “Office, 1–3 Oct” makes three entries in one go.

faq.q: What is the To do tab?
faq.a: A simple task list, separate from your habits. Give a task a due date and a reminder time if you like. To-dos never count in Stats.

faq.q: How do I back up my data?
faq.a: Go to **Settings → Your data** and export a CSV (for spreadsheets) or a JSON backup. Keep the file somewhere safe, like your email or cloud drive.

faq.q: Will I lose my data if I change phones?
faq.a: Export a JSON backup on the old phone and use **Settings → Your data → Import backup** on the new one. Importing merges with what is already there, so it is safe to run twice.

faq.q: My reminders don’t show up, or come late.
faq.a: Check that notifications are allowed in **Android Settings → Apps → Habit Tracker → Notifications**. On Android 14 and newer, also allow **Alarms & reminders** for on-time to-do reminders, and make sure battery saver isn’t stopping the app.

faq.q: How do I turn off anonymous stats?
faq.a: Go to **Settings → Privacy → Anonymous usage stats** and turn it off. Collection stops straight away.

termsNotes: Everything you log stays on your device. You are responsible for keeping your own backups.

faq.a: Yes. Each account has its own currency. The app uses daily European Central Bank rates, and you can set your own rate or add a custom currency.

faq.q: Is the Road to Billionaire financial advice?
faq.a: No. Milestones, the pace calculator and projections are illustrations to keep you motivated, not financial advice.

faq.q: How do I back up my data?
faq.a: Create an encrypted backup file and save it where you like, such as Google Drive. You can also export to CSV.
